results.q: Can I download/use the Circles application?
results.a: At the moment only research participants in Bali have been invited to access and use the Circles application. After the research is completed then the Project will look at options for collaborations to see how it may be possible for other users to access Circles Points.

results.q: When can my community try using the Circles application?
results.a: After the research being conducted in 2023 is completed, the Circles Project will look at how it may be possible for other communities to start using Circles Points in their area.

results.q: Who is already using Circles Points in Indonesia?
results.a: At the moment the only users of Circles Points are selected communities in the Balinese regencies of Jembrana, Tabanan and Denpasar who are participating in the Circles research activities in 2023.
